spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Joined, combined, connected, identified.
2 Attached to, engaged in or by.
3 Endowed with, possessed of.
n. (-तं)
A measure of four cubits.
E.
यु to join, &c., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Joined, combined.
n. (-कं)
1 Doubt, uncertainty.
2 A pair, a brace.
3 Nuptial presents.
4 The end of a cloth worn by women.
5 A garment worn by women; it is applied, it is said, both to the petticoat, and the upper wrapper or cloth.
6 The ends of a cloth.
7 The edge of a winnowing basket.
8

Forbearance, cessation.
10 Alliance, acquaintance, forming an alliance or friendship.
E.
युत joined, &c., कन् added.

f. (-तिः)
1 Joining, uniting.
2 (In arithmetic,) Addition.
E.
यु to join, क्तिन् aff.

f. (-तिः)
Joining, mixing.
E.
यु to join, aff. क्तिच्, and the vowel made long.
